name: Faulty Teamwork
body:
Benefit(s): When an ally who also has this feat fails her saving throw (including voluntarily failing the save) against a spell that would harm her with an area of effect that includes her, intelligent enemies within the spell’s area take a –2 penalty on their saving throws to resist the spell’s effects.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
